cards.context_en: Consent, coercion, power and agency cannot be established solely from clothing, a still pose, physical contact or facial appearance.

cards.context_en: A lowered gaze, touched sleeve or tear track may occur in multiple emotional contexts and does not establish a single internal state.

cards.context_en: A visible bruise, tear or damaged object is distinct from independently established violence, accident, perpetrator and event history.

cards.context_en: An empty chair, flower or card is not in itself proof of death, grief or a prior relationship.

cards.context_en: Class, income, housing security and conflict between work and aspirations cannot be established from an isolated garment or prop.

cards.context_en: Clothing structure, wear, school association, nationality, age and personality are separate claims; none follows automatically from another.
cards.context_ko: 의복 구조와 사용 상태, 학교 소속, 국적, 나이, 성격은 서로 다른 주장으로 어느 하나가 다른 것을 자동 확정하지 않는다.

cards.context_en: A check is a pattern and flannel is a fabric; neither label alone proves the other.
cards.context_ko: 체크는 무늬이고 플란넬은 원단이며 어느 한 명칭만으로 다른 하나를 입증할 수 없다.

cards.context_en: A single frame cannot establish a long take, rack focus, montage, jump cut or an earlier or later event.
